name: Fayda Identification Number (FIN)
note: The National ID Program's own services page (id.gov.et/services, saved 2026-10-28 for the identity documents and read again from that copy 2026-10-30; the site presented a certificate the proxy couldn't verify on 2026-10-30, not bypassed): Fayda is for all residents of Ethiopia; a resident registers in person at a registration centre with biometrics and documents and then receives a unique 12-digit Fayda Identification Number by SMS. Read as given on application, to residents. The page states no age, fee, time, check digit or what needs one.

sources.title: National ID Program (Fayda), Services
sources.said: Fayda is designed to provide all residents of Ethiopia with a secure digital ID with full unique identifier ... complete your registration in person by submitting your biometric data and approved documents. Once registered, you'll recieve your unique 12-digit Fayda Identification Number (FIN) via SMS to your mobile.
